title: A failed login, a refused registration with a taken username, then a new passenger with an empty account
description: A passenger tries to log in as fdse_microservice with a wrong password and the system refuses. They try to register a new passenger account with the already taken username fdse_microservice and the system refuses again. They register a new passenger account (username, password, gender, ID document, e-mail) and log in with the new username and password. They open the contact book, which is empty, refresh the list of orders for high-speed (GaoTie/DongChe) trains, where there are none yet, and look up the luggage consignments registered on the account, where there are none either.

steps.action: Log in as fdse_microservice with a wrong password (the system refuses)
Try to register a new passenger account with the already taken username fdse_microservice (the system refuses: the user already exists)
Register a new passenger account (username, password, gender, ID document, e-mail)
Log in with the new username and password
Open the contact book (it is empty)
Refresh the list of orders for high-speed (GaoTie/DongChe) trains (there are none yet)
Look up the luggage consignments registered on the account (there are none)
